latest_work.summary: Corrected the PPT entry path so a new deck must execute the context-aware HTML/GUI gallery when a local/desktop host is available. Expanded the live catalog from 4 to 10 registered previewable templates, added UTF-8 purpose-file transport for Windows Korean context, and strengthened Execution Contract v1.1 to require all registered templates + Free Design, up to 10 contextual recommendations, up to 6 detail previews, explicit user selection, and same-task resume into PPT generation.

fah_monitor_recovery.root_cause: repository source advanced after reviewed work while durable AI_STATE/latest handoff remained at onboarding bootstrap
fah_monitor_recovery.recovery_evidence: Subsequent natural monitor returned HEALTHY / ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_CURRENT before Execution Contract rollout.

fixed_rules: Technical source of truth remains this repository.
FAH monitor uses durable CURRENT authority before stale Registry bootstrap values.
GitHub Actions are default-off to conserve usage; they may be used when the current user explicitly requests emergency deployment or explicitly requests GitHub Actions.
Runtime deployment, backup and rollback are enabled only for supported declared capabilities.
Unknown or conflicting authority fails closed and must not be auto-rebaselined.
Every meaningful ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, automation or other tool modification must update durable latest state/history/handoff before completion so later agents share the exact modification state.
Before meaningful project execution, evaluate the declared FAH execution contract; decisions other than ALLOW or EXEMPT must not proceed.
Project-local fail-closed guards remain mandatory even when the FAH central contract returns ALLOW or EXEMPT.
For CREATE_PRESENTATION, execute the actual context-aware HTML/GUI gallery when a local or remote desktop host is available; do not substitute a prose template list.
The standard Slide Master selection catalog contains at least 10 previewable registered templates plus Free Design; user selection is mandatory and recommendations never auto-select.
After TEMPLATE_SELECTED evidence returns, resume the same PPT request immediately and initialize through new_deck_init.py; do not end the task at the selection prompt.
next_priority: Use the 10-template HTML/GUI gallery for the next new-deck request and resume generation immediately after explicit selection. No additional rollout work is required unless the GUI launcher itself fails.
